```yaml
name: Standards & Trust - Tier 1

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  npm-provenance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Publish with provenance
        run: npx changeset publish --provenance

  npm-trusted-publishers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      - name: Configure OIDC linking
        # This step would typically involve configuring OIDC in npm and GitHub Actions
        run: echo "Configure OIDC linking here"

  security-md:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Create SECURITY.md
        run: |
          echo "# Security Policy" > SECURITY.md
          echo "" >> SECURITY.md
          echo "## Disclosure Instructions" >> SECURITY.md
          echo "" >> SECURITY.md
          echo "If you discover a security vulnerability within this project, please report it immediately by contacting the maintainers." >> SECURITY.md
      - name: Enable Private Vulnerability Reporting
        # This step would typically involve enabling GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting in repo settings
        run: echo "Enable Private Vulnerability Reporting here"

  readme-badges:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Add shields.io badges
        run: |
          echo "[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@pare/package.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pare/package)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Downloads/month](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@pare/package.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pare/package)" >> README.md
          echo "[![CI Status](https://github.com/Dave-London/Pare/actions/workflows/main.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Dave-London/Pare/actions/workflows/main.yml)" >> README.md
          echo "[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)" >> README.md
          echo "[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-%3E%3D3.8-blue.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Node.js Version](https://img.shields.io/node/v/@pare/package.svg)](https://nodejs.org/)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Coverage](https://img.shields.io/codecov/c/github/Dave-London/Pare.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/Dave-London/Pare)"

  npm-2fa-enforcement:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Enable 2FA enforcement
        # This step would typically involve enabling 2FA enforcement in npm
        run: echo "Enable 2FA enforcement here"

  github-community-standards:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Complete community standards
        # This step would typically involve completing all items on the Community tab
        run: echo "Complete community standards here"

  spdx-license-verification:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Verify SPDX license
        run: |
          for file in $(find . -name "package.json"); do
            jq '. | select(.license == "MIT")' $file
          done

  openssf-scorecard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
        run: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ossf/scorecard/master/cli/download.sh | bash
        env:
          PATH: "$PATH:/usr/local/bin"
      - name: Add badge to README
        run: |
          echo "[![Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/Dave-London/Pare/badge)](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/Dave-London/Pare)" >> README.md
```
